comment: BIP 360 P2MR spend-path test vectors. Deterministic: privkeys are sha256('p2mr_spending/key/<n>'), prevout txids sha256('p2mr_spending/prevout/<n>'), BIP 340 signing with all-zero aux. The trees for txinIndex 3 and 4 are p2mr_single_leaf_script_tree and p2mr_different_version_leaves from p2mr_construction.json. For inputs spent without a signature, privkey/hashType/annex/sigMsg/sigHash are null.

inputSpending.comment: annex present: last witness element, covered by the signature
p2mr_single_leaf_script_tree: depth-0, script execution is skipped, no signature; anyone who knows the leaf script can spend (v0.12.0 rule)

scriptTree.description: just pushes the string 'BIP341' onto the stack

inputSpending.comment: p2mr_different_version_leaves through the 0xfa leaf: unknown leaf versions are unencumbered
depth-128 leaf: the control block is exactly the maximum 1 + 32*128 bytes

invalidSpending.comment: first byte of an otherwise valid signature flipped
one bit of the Merkle path flipped: the computed root no longer matches the witness program
the control byte's low bit is 0; Script Validation says it 'is unused and must be 1'
a P2MR witness needs at least a script and a control block

expected.error: annex with fewer than two remaining witness elements

invalidSpending.comment: with exactly two elements the last may not start with 0x50
a Merkle path of 129 elements exceeds the maximum depth of 128
a witness program needs a witness
the control block must carry at least the control byte
control block length must be 1 + 32*m: 34 bytes is not
